manifest.name: @learning-companion/windows
manifest.description: Learning Companion for Windows: the original display, captured with the user's explicit Start, and an overlay for navigation, questions and editable ink.

test_lines: ✔ the committed fixtures are exactly what the mapping emits from the retained manifests (45.6401ms)
✔ each retained sample keeps its facts exactly as retained: sample, held and stream counts, rounding, images and composition (4.0746ms)
✔ identities are the caller's, never the native labels or file names (2.515ms)
✔ raw and composed stay apart: one shared original, two identities for the same file, distinct files, and the separate editable ink (4.0801ms)
✔ a raw-only retained sample maps with no composition, and needs no composed binding (19.4103ms)
✔ known gaps keep their measured duration; older lines without one map to null, never inferred (4.6677ms)
✔ events without an image become frameless coverage, with what coverage cannot carry listed (4.2612ms)
✔ the end is not a record, a retained sample is not coverage, and an ended session is never sent as live (14.9167ms)
✔ a body over 4 MiB is refused (one retained sample standing for very many deferred samples); nothing is dropped (272.3271ms)
✔ a session whose manifest shows a forced end (unfinished), even without its ended line, is never sent as live (1.3723ms)
✔ bindings must be of exactly the retained file, of this source and kind; originals over 32 MiB are refused whole (4.4159ms)
✔ identities must be well formed and unique; one frame ID names one frame; an artifact ID names one original (6.0547ms)
✔ a torn or damaged manifest, or malformed facts, are refused as a whole; the inputs are not changed (5.1756ms)
✔ a retained composition that is missing or not an object is refused, never read as raw-only; explicit null stays raw-only (2.6795ms)
✔ coverage lines must hold what the producer writes; impossible facts are refused, not repaired (5.2296ms)
✔ every record is an external_app visual pixel observation; WindowsFrame keeps raw, composed and ink facts (1.836ms)
✔ the source must be exactly a SourceRef: extra members are refused, never copied into the closed wire (2.6494ms)
✔ a missing or falsy binding in the plan never turns a retained composition raw-only, nor drops the ink (3.1385ms)
✔ an unfinished record holds deferred samples only for lost frames, each before the last lost one (1.1176ms)
✔ only a cut-short last line is torn: a written line of kind "torn" is not coverage (1.0912ms)
✔ Stop while Start is still listing displays cancels it: no session and no overlay (51.4145ms)
✔ two Starts at once: one session and one overlay; the other is refused before anything is created (4.3608ms)
✔ a display grant whose display list arrives after Stop is refused (4.4965ms)
✔ a failing display list is refused exactly once and ends the session with the reason (3.8436ms)
✔ ink that cannot be written is kept through Stop and app close, exports with its pictures, and Retry writes it (18.9891ms)
✔ pictures that are not what they claim are not stored, and a missing picture is a gap that never blocks the ink (10.3955ms)
✔ while writing keeps failing, each picture is received once and kept; Retry writes all of them (16.9287ms)
✔ kept ink is never replaced or resolved by ink that does not continue it; its older saved version cannot be opened (10.7773ms)
✔ an export reads what it can: a picture it cannot read is listed as missing, and a failure reaches the user (9.6978ms)
✔ Stop during Start releases it: another Start is not blocked by the cancelled display listing (3.4068ms)
✔ Retry of ink kept from an earlier session does not take over the running session (14.3931ms)
✔ closing the app while Start lists displays cancels it; kept ink still holds the app open (7.2159ms)
✔ a save receives a bounded batch of pictures and names exactly those; the rest are received by the next saves, none lost (723.4665ms)
✔ a saved stroke carries the detail of what it was written over; unchanged it is verified, changed under it it is not (199.5467ms)

✔ QA-WIN-01 review: a formula changed in place while writing (x−1=2 → x+1=2, a separate 1 → 7, an answer 2 → 7; no pointer) is kept as a writing context, and the stroke is not verified on screen, in composed marks or in ASK (1601.359ms)
✔ the same formulas unchanged while writing: one context, verified, solid in composed marks and ASK (492.12ms)
✔ beyond the 8-context cap, each change under the stroke is counted once against what was seen before it: a repeat is not a change, a return is (4158.0109ms)
✔ below the cap nothing is counted: an unchanged frame adds no context, a change adds one (494.8835ms)
✔ a capture stream that arrives after Stop is stopped at once and never shown (4.9747ms)
✔ Stop while the capture is being armed asks for no stream (1.2769ms)
✔ a stream that is not the whole display, or carries audio, is stopped and ends the capture (2.502ms)
✔ the chosen display is shown when the stream arrives while capturing (1.1932ms)
✔ a sample reports the held image's own frame count and age; frames arriving while it is hashed are stream progress only (4.1356ms)
✔ an ASK card keeps the uncertainty drawn into its picture, even if alignment changes while the picture is encoded (26.9053ms)
✔ the overlay sends pictures in bounded batches and lets go only of those named as received or invalid (3.4321ms)
✔ pictures the main process does not receive stay in the overlay, and the ink stays marked not saved (1.5463ms)
✔ after Stop begins, no new writing is accepted; the stroke written before it is kept and saved before the Stop is confirmed (142.5743ms)
✔ when the capture ends by itself, new writing is refused at once, before the Stop arrives (5.1042ms)
✔ a whole-display frame queued for retention when Stop comes is still written, before the Stop is confirmed and the end is recorded (104.6873ms)
✔ retention on the real overlay: material steps are retained; past the limit each later step is recorded once; nothing stays pinned (235.7303ms)
✔ retention on the real overlay: a frame refused because writing failed is retried once writing works, carrying what it stood for (228.6133ms)
✔ S1: a torn line left by a partial append (disk full) is cut back at once, so the manifest stays valid even if nothing is appended again (59.4329ms)
✔ S1: when cutting the torn line fails too, nothing is acknowledged until it is cut, then every line is valid (24.7143ms)
✔ S2: a Stop whose overlay stops completing work is ended at the bound, and the retained frames still being written are recorded and shown as lost (10.506ms)
✔ S2: while the overlay keeps completing work, the Stop waits for it; the frames written then are not lost (12.6121ms)
✔ S1: when a failed first append left the whole header and a torn record, both are cut back, so the header is written once (31.7917ms)
✔ S2: a frame answered before the overlay's Stop report reached main is not reported lost (11.5713ms)
✔ S2: when the overlay's process is gone, frames it could not report are recorded and shown as possibly missing (10.4443ms)
✔ S2: a forced end before any whole-display frame could be taken writes no retention record (2.41ms)
✔ S2: a lost frame's deferred samples are recorded with it, and deferred steps are recorded at Stop, not after the slow work (234.0989ms)
✔ S2: malformed overlay messages do not count as completed work, so they do not keep a Stop waiting (118.9682ms)
✔ a frame larger than the chosen display is refused before its picture is decoded (5.6467ms)
✔ S3: when the final ended line cannot be written, the control window says so after the session, and it is written at the next Start (19.3147ms)
✔ R1: a known sampling gap is recorded with its measured duration even when the pixels did not change; a retained gap frame carries gap_ms (179.7809ms)
✔ R2: the header does not claim frame_age_ms equals monotonic_ms minus presentation_ms; the capture latency is unmeasured (10.3257ms)
✔ malformed facts, backwards runs and a truncated PNG are refused and write nothing (42.1779ms)
✔ retention rules: first frame; unchanged; small changes are a gap; material steps and ink changes, at most once per interval; heartbeat (25.7903ms)
✔ main retains a frame as PNG files by file SHA-256, lists it with the facts pinned with it, and records gaps and the end (53.2192ms)
✔ beyond the caps, frames are refused and recorded; nothing retained is deleted; a picture that is not the frame is refused (21.2802ms)
✔ when writing fails, the frame is refused and said; lines that could not be written are counted in the next that can (12.5197ms)
✔ the byte cap counts the files actually written; beyond it frames are refused as a limit; malformed facts never write (15.8867ms)
✔ a desktop session document reads back strictly, with its editable history and pixel evidence (4.7237ms)
✔ a forked copy keeps the whole ink, history and evidence under its own session id (0.5745ms)
✔ a desktop session document is refused when it is not what this version writes (1.4992ms)
✔ sample states: fresh frame, no new frame (still or stalled), a late period is a gap, the end ends (0.2228ms)
✔ a DIP region maps onto the frame at its scale, clipped (0.3275ms)
✔ luminance fingerprints: round trip and change (0.8571ms)
✔ QA-WIN-01: a line of text replaced by another under a narrow stroke is changed, though its 16×16 fingerprint barely moved (10.8781ms)
✔ the same content verifies, with a still mouse pointer or slight rendering noise (273.8383ms)
✔ a local change under a stroke is changed, never verified: a sign, a separate digit, an answer, or the pointer moving (28.4123ms)
✔ large regions: text scrolled under a large stroke is changed, though the fingerprint change is diluted; unchanged text verifies (76.6638ms)
✔ a small stroke whose word was replaced, or whose text left, is not verified; plain or missing pixels are unknown (1.844ms)
✔ ink with only the 16×16 fingerprint (saved before details were kept) is never verified; a large change still shows (0.3139ms)
✔ detail grids: square cells of at least 2 px, never more than DETAIL_CELLS; the change of grids of different sizes is a change (0.3087ms)
✔ stroke contexts: the starting picture first, then changes while writing, in order, with what was not observed (1.1611ms)
